scope: Source-backed evidence integration and bounded, development-only graph-completion/transfer pilots.

synthetic_checks.meaning: Implementation and leakage checks, not additional biological experiments. Some viewer checks require the retained original local measured scene and pinned atlas context assets.

archived_state.public: Code, tests, protocols, source URLs/hashes, frozen node partitions, fitted fly coefficients/scalers, prediction commitments, completion receipts and primary/independent-replay metric reports.
archived_state.not_bundled: Raw synapse tables, cached papers, .npy forecast arrays, complete generated HTML scenes and measured neuron geometry.
archived_state.exact_replay_requirement: The replay scripts require both the pinned raw inputs and original hash-matching forecast arrays. Those arrays are retained locally and were independently replayed, but are not included in this publication. The public package alone is therefore not a complete saved-forecast replay bundle.
archived_state.historical_identity: The mouse protocol pins the original fly FROZEN.json and PREDICTIONS_COMMITTED.json bytes; the latter contains the frozen parameters and standardizers. Preserve these archived bytes when inspecting transfer. Regenerating fly fits or timestamps creates a different run and does not replace this record.
archived_state.future_replication: Use an isolated development workspace and explicitly new run identity/protocol for regeneration. Never overwrite the archived receipts, bypass the one-run gates, or describe a repeat on these exposed specimens as an independent test.

local_map.prerequisites: Existing curated records/vocabulary, the local PVH sampling evidence graph, pinned original reports/swc_viewer.html, the pinned Allen ontology and context meshes specified in atlas_context_manifest.json. These are not all bundled by this checkpoint.
local_map.distribution: Generated full scene stays local under the measured trace terms. Context bindings are regional display annotations, never matched individual-cell coordinates.

interpretation: All pilots are development only. Fly results are within one fly; transfer is within one mouse visual-cortex volume. Neither establishes independent-animal, hypothalamic, whole-axon-path, intervention-response or longevity prediction.
